system.description: The Stormkelt is granted night vision for one minute. With night vision the dimwalker is able to see in pitch-black darkness, though not quite as well as if it were daytime. The dimwalker has clear vision up to 20 meters, beyond which the v isibility of details is diminished considerably and ends completely after about 60 meters.
